name: Winter Storm / Power Outage
summary: Severe winter weather and a long power outage — warming centers, welfare checks, and fuel/generator management.

objectives: Open and staff warming centers at pre-identified facilities that have backup power.
Conduct welfare checks on vulnerable residents — medically dependent, elderly, and isolated.
Coordinate with utilities on restoration priorities and estimated times; relay updates to the public.
Support transport of residents to warming centers and of medical patients to care.
Track fuel and generator status for every critical facility and refuel before any runs dry.
Monitor road conditions and advise the public to stay off the roads unless travel is essential.
Push carbon-monoxide and generator-safety messaging to the public throughout the outage.
data.safety_message: Dress for the cold and rotate crews out of exposure — watch each other for frostbite and hypothermia. Generators and heaters make carbon monoxide: run them outdoors only, never in a garage or near a window or air intake. Drive only when necessary and slow down for ice. Report downed lines and treat every line as energized.
